Class ProcessedFileRecord

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.ProcessedFileRecord
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    PropertyConsumer

    class ProcessedFileRecord
extends java.lang.Object
implements PropertyConsumer
    Table model representing the processing status of an individual file.
